pharmasync.tagline: CRM & mobile app for laboratories and pharmacies
pharmasync.description: PharmaSync digitizes all the activity of medical representatives: visit planning, field reports, objective tracking and real-time sales management. Reps work from their phone, even offline; managers follow activity live from their dashboard.
pharmasync.mobileText: The representative's app for iOS and Android: rounds, reports and geolocation, even offline.

roles.title: For management
roles.text: Reliable indicators: coverage rate, schedule compliance, report quality.
